sockets.notes: Aft end of the ship; the module origin.
Axle centre. Rotor and carrier are placed here; rotate the rotor only, about game X.

passages.notes: PROVISIONAL centreline crew passage: |y| <= 2.30 = the clear band between the port and starboard deck-slot clearances (3.45 - 2.3/2), narrowed 2026-09-25 to touch (not overlap) the slot clearances widened for the real cannon; height 3.4 u = 1.7 m crew (WorldScale.Person) at 0.5 m/u. Starts at X 3.16, the forward edge of the measured wheel housing ironwork. NOTE the helm (X 4.22-4.58, |y| <= 0.8) stands inside it.

hydrostatics.notes: Astra 2026-09-24: Hull_Shell only, upright level flotation; see docs/modular-reference/MODULAR-HYDROSTATICS-HANDOFF.md.

lightship.rule: Seeded 2026-09-24 so stern + 1 middle + bow = today's steamer mass (hullform.json massKg x 0.42^3 = 31906.6 kg), split by each section's table volume to the deck. Wheel, carrier and chimney carry 0: today's mass is one lump.

holdCells.source: 16 x this section's table volume to the deck / the Long ship's, largest remainder

berths.source: today's deck stations standing in this section on the Long ship

gunSlots.source: today's gun pair 3 (z -1.26 m) stands 6 mm aft of the stern/middle join

capacity.rule: Seeded 2026-09-24 (A4) ONCE so stern + 1 middle + bow = today's steamer exactly (16 hold cells, 8 berths, 6 guns = 3 pairs): hold cells = 16 split by each section's hydrostatic-table volume to the deck (largest remainder); berths = today's 8 deck stations (SteamerBootstrap.DeckStation) counted in the section whose X range contains them; gun slots = the port/starboard deck slot nearest to today's gun socket (hullform.json gunSockets, x0.42) in the section that contains it. PROVISIONAL: tune freely; the shipyard sums whatever is here.

physical.notes: NOT AUTHORED. Must not be inferred from mesh size, section length or wheel radius.
